Mr. President,

The Atlantic picture for September is a hard one. Allied merchant losses to U-boats come to 209,835 GRT, and we reckon 30 boats operational in the Atlantic on the July to September average. The convoys need every escort we can spare.

Respectfully,
H. R. Stark
